Author: Luci
Name: WindowResize+
Description: WindowResize+ sets the FFXIV game window to an arbitrary size beyond your display resolution. It is useful for high-resolution screenshots without going fullscreen and requires borderless or windowed mode.
Punchline: Resize your FFXIV window beyond your display resolution.
Changelog:
### 1.0.0
- First standalone WindowResize+ release.
- Added editable target dimensions, resolution presets, a resolution toggle, and a configurable hotkey (F10 by default).
- The resized game window stays centered.
- Added optional preservation of game HUD, GPose controls, and ordinary Dalamud plugin window scale and placement across resolution and aspect-ratio changes.
- Added serialized resize/restoration handling, safer failure reporting and retry behavior, multi-monitor coordinate support, and automated regression tests.
- /wresize toggles the plugin window.

Author: Luci
Name: XIV Instant Edit
Description: Enables easy importing of Penumbra model files in Blender and exporting them back to the game with just a single click. Provides various utilities and settings to make mod creation and editing easier and faster.
Punchline: Send Penumbra model files to Blender and back with a single click.
Changelog:
### 1.2.3
- Improved material previews for hair, eyebrows, and eyelashes in the Blender add-on.
- Fixed a stale warning that could appear after creating a Mashup.
- The Toolbox now highlights the currently selected mesh part.

### 1.2.2
- Added glTF (.gltf/.glb) support to Simple Import in the Blender add-on.
- Fixed the Blender add-on's sidebar tab label colliding with Yet Another Addon's.
- Improved performance of on-screen resource source lookups for large mod lists.
- Streamlined the On Screen resource tree to only show items Instant Edit can actually edit.
- Fixed a mesh-renaming bug in the Toolbox where hidden objects could block valid renames.
- Fixed a Quick Export validation edge case involving stray Penumbra mod identities.
- Reduced managed Blender cache backup retention from 30 to 7 days.
- Simplified Quick Export's automatic Penumbra attribute-group toggle.
- Various internal cleanup and refactoring.

### 1.2.1
- Improved Blender status message display and fixed a performance issue with Blender UI draw calls; hidden part tags are now suppressed.
- Various internal cleanup and refactoring.

### 1.2.0
- Added texture editing support with 32-bit TGA workflows.
- Added armature-combine support in the Toolbox.
- Added animation editing and startup animation generation.
- Improved Penumbra 1.7 compatibility, export handoff, diagnostics, path handling, and validation.
- Added automatic Penumbra attribute-group creation for Quick Export.
- Added the in-plugin changelog viewer and first-time setup flow.

Author: Luci
Name: XIV Port Studio
Description: Toolkit for porting outfits from other games into FFXIV. Pick an item, then define the materials and textures it should use so the result can be exported as a Penumbra mod.
Punchline: Set up materials and textures for imported FFXIV gear.

Author: Luci
Name: Advanced Penumbra Mod Converter
Description: Convert gear, facewear, hair, face, tail and Viera-ear assets in Penumbra mods to other items, slots and races. Supports the Penumbra 1.7+ mod format, retargets game paths, model/material references and metadata, previews every change, and can revert conversions.
Punchline: Move Penumbra mods to other items, slots and races.
Changelog:
### 1.1.1
- Renamed from Advanced Penumbra Item Converter. The commands are now /apmc and /apmcconfig. Settings and conversion history from 1.1.0 do not carry over.

### 1.1.0
- First testing release in the shared repository.
- Redesigned two-pane window with background previews, a plan view and a conversion history with Revert.
- Gear slot changes warn that the model keeps its geometry; unwanted mesh groups can be removed before converting.
- Hair, face, tail and ear targets are limited to options players can choose, labelled like "Face 101 (Keeper of the Moon)".
- Lalafell convert only among Lalafell; faces stay within their gender.
